sections.heading: GTK
sections.text: Complete set of UI elements, GTK is suitable for projects ranging from small one-off tools to complete application suites. GTK is written using the C programming language, but its also available to various programming languages through language bindings Links: GTK Documentation

sections.heading: PyGObject
sections.text: PyGObject is a Python package which provides bindings for GObject based libraries such as GTK, GStreamer, WebKitGTK, GLib, GIO and many more. Links: PyGObject GNOME Python API documentation : This site contains documentation for the latest release of the GNOME libraries: GTK 4, LibAdwaita, etc.

sections.heading: Libadwaita
sections.text: Adwaita offers application developers many widgets and objects to build GNOME applications scaling from desktop workstations to mobile phones. Links: Latest 1.x stable version
